integrity: All boundary cases, the global calculus minimization, and the two-band triangle-obstruction construction are proved in the accompanying manuscript; finite calculations are not used as a replacement for proof. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar multiples of nontrivial band projections on Lp with finite p and 0<=t<1 are classified; arbitrary contractions, conditional expectations and p=infinity are not covered. Searches may miss unindexed equivalent work.
title: Sharp defect-norm thresholds for band projections on \(L_p\)
